title_zh: 不用手机，查清一项公共服务并带着纸质结果离开
title_en: Without a smartphone, understand one public service and leave with a paper result

persona.zh: 无智能手机的老年访客

task.purpose_zh: 查清办理一项公开公共服务需要哪些材料，以及线下去哪里继续办理
task.purpose_en: Understand the required materials for a public service and where to continue offline
task.candidate_setting: Learning Works or another authorized public-service node

spatial_sequence.action_zh: 沿静态编号和连续无障碍路径到达
spatial_sequence.action_en: Arrive by static numbering and a continuous accessible route

spatial_sequence.action_zh: 不注册、不扫码，说清要办的事
spatial_sequence.action_en: State the task without registering or scanning
spatial_sequence.ai_role: may classify the question after consent

spatial_sequence.action_zh: 读一张写明来源日期的材料清单
spatial_sequence.action_en: Read a plain-language checklist carrying a source date
spatial_sequence.ai_role: may draft a shorter explanation from dated public sources

spatial_sequence.action_zh: 由工作人员核对关键事实并签字
spatial_sequence.action_en: Have a staff member verify and sign critical facts
spatial_sequence.no_ai_path: staff checks the public source directly

spatial_sequence.action_zh: 坐下来重看材料，缺一项就回到柜台补问
spatial_sequence.action_en: Sit, reread, and return to the counter if one item is unclear

spatial_sequence.action_zh: 带走纸质结果和问题编号，沿同一连续路径离开
spatial_sequence.action_en: Leave with the paper result and issue number along the same continuous route
spatial_sequence.ai_role: may add an anonymized issue category only

success_conditions: the whole task can be completed without a smartphone, account, face scan, or personal route history
critical information carries a dated public source and human sign-off
the arrival and exit route is continuous and can be replayed by an access-first reviewer
the visitor leaves with a paper checklist, service location, expiry note, and issue number
stop_conditions: a route segment is blocked or unsafe
the public source is stale or a critical fact cannot be confirmed
the human takeover counter is unstaffed
the visitor cannot leave by a safe equivalent route
claim_boundary: This is a spatial design and service-acceptance script. It records no real visitor, completed journey, site authorization, or field performance.
